lines.en: Which bus goes to the museum?
Bus seven, Grandma. Then we transfer to the subway.
lines.ko: 칠 번 버스요, 할머니. 그다음 지하철로 갈아타요.

lines.en: Is the subway crowded now?
A little. It's morning, so many people ride.
Last time we took the wrong route.
I remember. After that, we arrived late.
Today let's check the platform sign.
Okay. The train will depart in five minutes.
lines.ko: 알겠어요. 열차가 오 분 후에 출발할 거예요.

lines.en: Do you have your ticket?
Yes. I will hold it carefully.
Hello. I want to buy a train ticket.
Sure. Where are you going?
To the city. My daughter lives there.
The next train departs at ten. Is that okay?
lines.ko: 다음 기차는 열 시에 출발해요. 괜찮으세요?

lines.en: Yes. When will it arrive?
It will arrive at one. Platform two.
lines.ko: 한 시에 도착할 거예요. 이 번 승강장이에요.

lines.en: Is the train crowded in the morning?
Not much. Yesterday it was very empty.
Good. Here is the money. Thank you.
Here is your ticket. Have a safe trip.
